description: This PHP file defines the class 'LangStringHelper' which provides utility functions for handling language strings within the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for database interactions (fetching group IDs, inserting, updating, and deleting language strings), as well as reading language strings from YAML files.

classes.name: LangStringHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods for managing language strings in the database, including CRUD operations and reading from YAML files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance for building database queries.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of LanguageHelper; initializes it if not already created.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a language group given its name.

methods.name: deleteNonCustomizedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings that are not marked as customized for a given group.

methods.name: getLangStringIdsForGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all language string IDs associated with a specific group.

methods.name: getNonCustomizedLangStringIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of language strings that are not customized within a group.

methods.name: insertOrUpdateLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from YAML files in a directory and inserts or updates them in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByValueAndGroup
methods.description: Finds the ID of a language string given its value and optionally its group ID.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByUnitIdAndGroup
methods.description: Finds the ID of a language string given its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: saveLangString
methods.description: Inserts a new language string record into the database.

methods.name: updateLangString
methods.description: Updates an existing language string record in the database.
